player_prompt.intro:
You are playing PegJump. Jump one peg over another into an empty hole, removing the jumped peg.
Goal: finish with exactly **one** peg left. Action format: e.g. '[4 1]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: B sẽn gʋls tɩ [i->j] pa zemse.
invalid_move.illegal_move: B sẽn maan bũmb ning n pa zems ne tõogã.

outcome.no_moves: B pa le tõe n kẽn ye.
